verdict.product_or_enabler: ENABLER wearing a product's clothes. What it proves (the repo works from a clone) serves CONTRIBUTORS, not strangers. A stranger leaves knowing '5 suites pass' — a fact about the repo — with no reason to care. The smallest thing that WOULD be a product: five answered questions with numbers (router saves X% on 237 recorded turns; 7/7 mutations caught so the demo can still fail; X% of context retransmitted; cap would have cost $Y/turn; recorded judgment: fewer_turns at 0.7). That is five facts about the WORLD (agent cost), printable from committed bytes today, and it is what I would build.
